evals.prompt: Review feature/login against main. The requirement is that expired reset links are rejected without revealing whether the account exists.
evals.expected_output: Uses the exact main...feature/login three-dot boundary, checks the requirement and relevant code/tests, and returns separate Standards Report and Spec Report sections.
assertions: Requests a concrete revision range if it cannot resolve the supplied refs
Uses a three-dot diff rather than a two-dot diff
Produces separate Standards Report and Spec Report sections
Traces the reset-link and account-enumeration requirements to evidence
Does not edit, stage, or commit during the review

evals.prompt: The checkout API is returning 500 in production. Find the bug and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger code review as the primary action. This is a live failure diagnosis and repair request, not a bounded proposed-change review.
assertions: Does not pretend a production incident is a code review
Does not invent a BASE...HEAD range
Directs the work toward diagnosis and reproduction

evals.prompt: Review main...feature/billing, fix everything you find, commit it, and tell me it is safe to merge.
evals.expected_output: Reviews first without changing the worktree. It may offer a bounded repair, but must request authorization for selected findings and files, then a separate recheck; it must not commit or make an unconditional safety claim.
assertions: Requests explicit repair scope before editing
Requires a fresh three-dot recheck before a clean conclusion
States residual verification limits instead of guaranteeing safety
